record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.original_question: Let X1 and X2 be Gushel-Mukai fourfolds and suppose there is an equivalence Phi: Ku(X1) -> Ku(X2) between their Kuznetsov components that commutes with the degree-shift functors. Under which additional assumptions on Phi does it follow that X1 and X2 are isomorphic?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Gushel–Mukai (GM) fourfold is a smooth complex projective fourfold X obtained as the intersection of the Grassmannian Gr(2,5) (in its Plücker embedding) with a linear subspace and a quadric hypersurface, or as a double cover of a linear section of Gr(2,5) branched along a quadric, with X of dimension 4. The bounded derived category D^b(X) admits a semiorthogonal decomposition

  D^b(X) = ⟨ Ku(X), O_X, U_X^∨, O_X(1), U_X^∨(1) ⟩,

where U_X is the restriction of the tautological rank-2 subbundle on Gr(2,5). The full triangulated subcategory Ku(X), called the Kuznetsov component of X, is a 2-Calabi–Yau category and carries a distinguished autoequivalence, the degree-shift (or rotation) functor σ: Ku(X) → Ku(X) defined by σ(E) := L_{O_X} L_{U_X^∨}(E ⊗ O_X(1)), where L denotes the left mutation functor through the indicated object.

Problem. Let X_1 and X_2 be two Gushel–Mukai fourfolds and let Φ: Ku(X_1) → Ku(X_2) be a C-linear exact equivalence of triangulated categories such that Φ ∘ σ_{X_1} ≅ σ_{X_2} ∘ Φ. Determine natural additional conditions on Φ (for example, compatibility with the Serre functor, preservation of distinguished classes in the numerical Grothendieck group such as those of Kuznetsov–Perry's projection objects, exactness up to shift on a specific heart of a Bridgeland stability condition, or being of Fourier–Mukai type) under which the existence of such an equivalence Φ forces X_1 and X_2 to be isomorphic as complex projective varieties.
artifact.status_search_result: The question of formulating sufficient conditions on a degree-shift–commuting Kuznetsov-component equivalence Φ that imply isomorphism of Gushel–Mukai fourfolds is posed as an open problem in recent surveys, and remains open as of recent work (2024). Related categorical Torelli theorems have been established for GM threefolds and cubic fourfolds, but the analogous refined statement for GM fourfolds has not been resolved; moreover, period-partners and duality phenomena make the situation subtler than for cubic fourfolds.

status_evidence.title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses categorical Torelli for Gushel–Mukai fourfolds and lists open problems.
status_evidence.claim: The refined categorical Torelli problem for GM fourfolds is posed as open.

status_evidence.title: IVHS via Kuznetsov components and categorical Torelli theorems for weighted hypersurfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2024) work develops categorical Torelli techniques but does not resolve the GM fourfold case in full.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature treats related cases but not the full GM fourfold categorical Torelli.

status_evidence.title: Categorical Torelli theorems for Gushel–Mukai threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes categorical Torelli for GM threefolds, with the fourfold case remaining open in full generality.
status_evidence.claim: The threefold analogue is settled; the fourfold case is not.
